frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_hart_evt
(m_vlsit_pmu_hart_evt)
NEW
blocks.function: Collects the implemented per-hart event vectors and retains source-hart identity.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_cluster_evt
(m_vlsit_pmu_cluster_evt)
NEW
blocks.function: Collects cluster-global event sources such as LLC and fabric events without inventing per-hart attribution.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_event_select
(m_vlsit_pmu_event_select)
NEW
blocks.function: Selects a programmed event and applies scope 0–3 hart, 4 aggregate, or 5 cluster-global.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_aggregate
(m_vlsit_pmu_aggregate)
NEW
blocks.function: Adds simultaneous per-hart occurrences; four matching hart events in one cycle increment by four.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_counter_bank
(m_vlsit_pmu_counter_bank)
NEW
blocks.function: Implements PARA_PMU_COUNTER_NUM counters, modulo-2^W wrap, event selection and enable state.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_snapshot
(m_vlsit_pmu_snapshot)
NEW
blocks.function: Captures a coherent read image on the software snapshot command and holds it for low/high reads.

label: u_vlsit_pmu_irq
(m_vlsit_pmu_irq)
NEW
blocks.function: Latches enabled overflow causes and drives one aggregate level interrupt until software clears causes.

interfaces.name: Per-hart event vectors
interfaces.signals: Candidate CVA6 performance counters and per-hart cache events; exact source availability and selector IDs are pending.

interfaces.name: PMU selector output
interfaces.signals: One selected source and scope; no increment for reserved or unavailable sources.

interfaces.name: Event multiplicity
interfaces.signals: Unsigned occurrence count per cycle; scope 4 sums active-hart events.

interfaces.name: Counter snapshot capture
interfaces.signals: Atomic capture of configured counter values on accepted command.

interfaces.name: Counter overflow status
interfaces.signals: Overflow pulses are converted to sticky per-counter cause bits.

interfaces.name: CSR PMU configuration
interfaces.signals: Selector, scope, enable, snapshot and clear controls; workbook controls offsets.

interfaces.name: Stable PMU read image
interfaces.signals: Snapshot values remain stable until the next accepted snapshot or reset.

interfaces.name: Aggregate PMU interrupt
interfaces.signals: Single level output follows enabled pending sticky causes.

legend_note: The source event dictionary and exact CVA6 performance-event wire mapping remain open. The diagram does not claim that all listed candidate events exist in the selected CVA6 revision. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
